integrity: Correctness rests on an exact zero-sum pendant-cut identity, explicit cycle Fourier diagonalization, and positive-semidefinite perturbation theory; included finite computation is corroboration, not an infinite proof. The uniform corona spectrum is prior art; literature equivalence outside inspected sources is a residual risk.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge finite cycle with one leaf at each vertex, uniform initial positive leaf lengths, lengthenings only; sharp site-count rigidity holds for arbitrary positive increment sizes, but optimal placement/allocation only to first order. No powered-metric extensions or finite-budget optimal placement claimed.
title: Two-site rigidity and optimal placement for Hilbert stiffness of weighted cyclic sunlets
